pullRequests.title: Unify the repository with rac1-decomp: layout, licence, docs, agent queue
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: unify-structure
pullRequests.body:
Brings rac-deadlocked-decomp in line with rac1-decomp, the reference layout for the OpenRAC decompilations, and ports rac1's agent queue.
Commits

Relicense under GPL-3.0, like rac1-decomp and rac2-gc-decomp. libgcc and libm keep their own notices.
Overlay sources and near misses laid out like rac1: src/overlays/shared/ holds code in two or more levels (48 files) and src/overlays/lNN_<level>/ code in one level (29 files). Near misses go to nonmatching/<area>/func_X.c, with a README generated by…
